name: Phantasmal Staff
body:
Price 34,000 gp; Aura moderate illusion; CL 8; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This staff is made of a light, white wood whose surface is matte and the grains and knots seem to shift and move. It allows use of the following spells:

phantasmal assailants (1 charge)
phantasmal strangler (1 charge)
phantasmal decoy (2 charges)
phantasmal killer (2 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 17,000 gp; Feats Craft Staff; Spells phantasmal assailants, phantasmal decoy, phantasmal killer, phantasmal strangler
